name: Sonar System Engineering
description: Introduction to sonar types and applications; basic acoustics concepts; physical quantities and units; active and passive sonar equations and their limitations; transducers, directionality and arrays; generation of underwater sound – radiated and self-noise of ships; ambient noise background in the sea; propagation of sound in the sea – characteristics, types of sound channels, ray and modal theories; reflection and scattering by sonar targets; sound scattering in the sea and reverberation; detection of signals in noise and reverberation using active and passive sonars; sonar system design and performance estimation.
